assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 100% increase from the same period last year, driven by a sharp rise in reported cases.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with an 853% increase from the same period last year, indicating a significant surge in reported cases.
Mpox cases in the US are peaking with an 87% increase from the same period last year, though the number of cases has decreased compared to the previous year.
Global flu test positivity is peaking at 11.5%, up 26% from the previous month, with US hospital admissions also rising sharply.
Polio Wikipedia readership is at the 97th percentile of the past year, indicating heightened public interest but no reported cases.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a 1388% increase from the same period last year, though the number of cases has decreased compared to the previous year.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline with a 30% increase from the same period last year, and there are new locally acquired cases reported in Switzerland.
Group A strep Wikipedia readership is at the 55th percentile of the past year, indicating moderate public interest but no significant reported cases.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising, with a 45% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising, with a 55% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Global RSV test positivity is rising, with a 62% increase in the latest week compared to the previous month.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are slightly rising, with a 5% increase over the past month.
Hepatitis A cases in the US are slightly rising, with a 10% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Malaria cases in the US are slightly rising, with a 30% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months.
Typhoid fever Wikipedia readership is rising, but there are no reported cases in the US.
